title: Elucidation of the structural dynamics of mutations in PHB2 protein associated with growth suppression and cancer progression.
authors: Khatua, Susmita; Roy, Alankar; Sen, Pritha; Ray, Sujay
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子动力学模拟分析PHB2蛋白点突变对线粒体复合物稳定性的影响，但对象为蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Prohibitin is a multifunctional protein that plays an important role in numerous cellular processes. Membrane-associated mitochondrial prohibitin complex is made up of two subunits, PHB1 and PHB2 which are ubiquitously expressed and analogous to each other. High levels of prohibitin expression have consequently been found in esophageal cancer, endometrial adenocarcinoma, gastric cancer, hepatocellular carcinoma, breast cancer and bladder cancer. The aim of this study is to analyse two-point mutation PHB2_MT1(I --> A) and PHB2_MT2(I --> P), their effect on PHB2 protein and its effect on formation of mitochondrial complex. It is a residual level study, based on current experimental validation. To establish the effects of the two-point mutations, computational approaches such as molecular modelling, molecular docking, normal mode simulation, molecular dynamics simulations and MM/GBSA were used. An analysis of the energy dynamics of both unbound and complex proteins was conducted to elucidate how mutations impact the energy distribution of PHB2. Our study confirmed that the two mutations decreased the overall stability of PHB2. This was evidenced by heightened atomic fluctuations within the mutated region, accompanied by elevated deviations observed in RMSD and R(g) values. Furthermore, these mutations were correlated with a decline in the organization of secondary structural elements. The mutations in PHB2_MT1 and PHB2_MT2 resulted in formation a less stable prohibitin complex. Thus, PHB1 and PHB2 may act as molecular target or novel biomarkers for therapeutic intervention in numerous forms of malignancies.
abstract_zh: Prohibitin是一种多功能蛋白，在众多细胞过程中发挥重要作用。线粒体相关的膜结合prohibitin复合物由两个亚基PHB1和PHB2组成，它们普遍表达且彼此相似。因此，在食管癌、子宫内膜腺癌、胃癌、肝细胞癌、乳腺癌和膀胱癌中发现了高水平的prohibitin表达。本研究旨在分析两点突变PHB2_MT1（I --> A）和PHB2_MT2（I --> P）对PHB2蛋白的影响及其对线粒体复合物形成的作用。这是一项基于当前实验验证的残基水平研究。为确定两点突变的影响，采用了分子建模、分子对接、简正模式模拟、分子动力学模拟和MM/GBSA等计算方法。对未结合和复合蛋白的能量动态进行了分析，以阐明突变如何影响PHB2的能量分布。我们的研究证实，这两种突变降低了PHB2的整体稳定性。这通过突变区域内原子波动的增强以及RMSD和R(g)值中观察到的升高偏差得到证明。此外，这些突变与二级结构元素组织的下降相关。PHB2_MT1和PHB2_MT2中的突变导致形成稳定性较低的prohibitin复合物。因此，PHB1和PHB2可能作为多种恶性肿瘤治疗干预的分子靶点或新型生物标志物。
